info.title: Sendcrux Universal API
info.description: Sendcrux is an email marketing and cold outreach platform for managing lists, subscribers, campaigns, delivery events, and related account resources through its REST API.

post.description: Creates a custom field for an email list in Sendcrux.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

default_value.description: The default value for the custom field.

label.description: The display label for the new custom field.

tag.description: The unique field tag used by Sendcrux for this custom field.

type.description: The Sendcrux field type, such as text.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the list to extend with a custom field.

contact_country_id.description: The numeric country identifier for the list contact profile.

contact_email.description: The contact email address for the list profile.

default_subject.description: The default subject line for campaigns that use this list.

send_welcome_email.description: Set to 1 to send the Sendcrux welcome email to new subscribers.

subscribe_confirmation.description: Set to 1 to require confirmation when people subscribe.
